Name: Pause Walder
Information:
**Pause Walder**

Pause Walders are cursed plants that were born from a misguided attempt to animate plants to become guardians and attack dogs. They were originally created in an attempt to protect the Deep Pause Temple, but they went rogue and developed a thirst for blood. The first generation of Pause Walders were destroyed, but their seeds caused other plants to mutate and spread, leading to them appearing across Somnus Domina.

**Body of Twisting Roots**

The body of the Pause Walder is made of freeforming roots that can reconfigure themselves into various forms, and so when they are inactive they can appear to be basic, uninteresting plant matter. They generally remain inactive and inert, unless the possibility of drinking mortal blood presents itself, or they risk starving.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While it remains motionless, the walder is indistinguishable from a shrub, small tree, or clump of roots.

actions.name: Bramble Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage, and if the target is prone they must make a DC 11 Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are grappled and restrained by the walder (escape DC 13).

bonus_actions.name: Leap
bonus_actions.description: The walder jumps through the air, moving a distance equal to its remaining movement speed (which it uses in the process), and if it ends this leap in a space adjacent to a hostile creature, it can force them to make a Strength save as though hit by its Bramble Strike, possibly grappling them.
